name: programmable-art-vendor
description: Builds web/js/art-store-turbo.js and web/js/art-store-irys.js, the browser stores of the real storage services, from sdk/src/artstore-turbo.ts and sdk/src/artstore-irys.ts. Kept apart from the SDK workspace so their packages never reach the SDK, the site's other bundles or the server.
